notes.title: Release date – Celestial Empire coming out SOON!
notes.notes:
Governors!

The wait is finally over! After months of anticipation, questions, and curiosity, we can proudly share the long-awaited news. We officially announce that Celestial Empire will launch in Early Access on September 23rd, 2025, 11:00 UTC!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38094144/58a261570d2bfc3bdd43c955daa59207a0cdfe15.png"]

The Early Access release covers all the core features and promised content of the game, with regular updates and expansions planned along the way. Our Early Access journey is expected to last about a year, during which we want you – the players – to be an essential part of Celestial Empire’s growth and development.


[previewyoutube="lN7aIRUTxq0;full"][/previewyoutube]


So, mark your calendars, add the game to your wishlist (if you haven’t done it already ekhm ekhm), and get ready to build the city of your dreams!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330430/Celestial_Empire/"][/dynamiclink]

With hand-crafted maps, stunning natural landscapes, and detailed architecture inspired by ancient China, Celestial Empire offers a unique city-building experience crafted with care. Will you prove worthy of the title The Great Governor?


Thank you for your patience and support – we can’t wait for you to join us in shaping the Empire together. September 23rd is just the beginning! Got some questions? Check out our discord!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38094144/cead38c511a75b05f145acb7e1199dbfa8dd5be4.png"]

notes.title: Celestial Empire's Release Date
notes.notes:
Constructors!

After a round of heated discussions, we managed to make some decisions on ETA for Celestial Empire’s release. As you may have realized, 2023 was a year given on Steam as the estimated time of the game’s release and that applies no longer. Our new estimated time of arrival for Celestial Empire is the first quarter of 2024.

Some time ago, we launched playtests and shared the demo version of the game, so we could make new, solid estimations. Our decision is based on all the thoughts you’ve shared with us – we listen to you and believe that this additional time will let us pitch the game to its best state. The amount of feedback you’ve sent us is astonishing – over 1000 feedback reports and trust us, we’re analyzing every single one of them! We don’t want to release an incomplete, messy product with annoying bugs, so… based on what we’ve heard from you, we decided to really work on such things as optimization, creating a thorough tutorial and balancing mechanics. There are some things we should improve, and well, we wouldn’t want to let you down, now would we?

Thank you for your constant support and, hopefully, see you at the full game’s release!

The Devs
